documents.name: Meirav Shetrit Background
documents.source: Meirav Shetrit is a popular Israeli fitness coach and social media influencer known for her motivational workout content and body-positive messaging. She has built a large following on Instagram and YouTube with home workout videos, gym training sessions, and nutrition guidance. Meirav specializes in functional fitness and HIIT training. Her content is accessible to beginners and experienced athletes alike. She promotes a balanced approach to fitness that emphasizes consistency over perfection. Meirav is known for her energetic, encouraging coaching style. She has launched digital fitness programs and challenges that have attracted thousands of participants. Her nutrition content focuses on whole foods, adequate protein, and sustainable eating habits. She often shares her own fitness journey including setbacks and comebacks. Meirav collaborates with Israeli and international sportswear and health brands. She is a certified fitness trainer and constantly updates her knowledge. Her community is known for being supportive and inclusive. She regularly hosts live workout sessions and Q&As. Meirav is considered one of Israel's leading fitness influencers.
